$comment: Dependency-audit exceptions (M1-CI-03). Every entry MUST have a reason, an `added` date and an `expires` date (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 90 days after `added`) and the advisory id (GHSA-... or the numeric npm advisory id). scripts/ci/audit.mjs fails the build when an entry is expired, and warns when it no longer matches anything (delete it). Changes need CODEOWNERS review. See docs/engineering/ci.md.

entries.reason: ReDoS in extglob matching; no patched release is published yet (patched_versions: none). Reached only through dev tooling (vitest, tinyglobby, eslint-config-next); never installed in the runtime image (`pnpm deploy --prod`) and never fed untrusted glob patterns.
